A pragmatic leader who balanced Sollist traditions with populist reforms, earning the trust of the common citizen. Charismatic and idealistic, he presents himself as a man of the people, promising a new era of unity and prosperity.

The Old Guard are the Sollists from the old administration who defend the status quo and promote conservative politics. Some claim that they established a deep state that controls the state apparatus.

The Oligarchs are the few powerful elite who control the majority of the wealth in Sordland. Their influence, both in and out of Sordland, have been growing due to the privatization efforts in the past.

The Reformists are the representatives in the government united under the call for the democratic reforms. Over the previous years, they have been gaining popularity since the failed rule of the previous government.

You are my enslavement and my freedom,
You are my flesh burning like a raw summer night,
You are my country.

Anton Rayne has been elected the 4th President of Sordland amidst a deep recession, demands for reform and external pressures. His victory followed a campaign focused on turning a new page and recovery from economic hardship, striking a chord with a divided electorate. 

Now, as his administration takes shape, uncertainty lingers in the halls of power. Rayne faces a nation burdened by institutional fatigue, cautious optimism and the quiet urgency of change.

"Monarch, your reign and your abode,
Your scepter, and the orb you hold,
And e'en the ground on which you trod,
All will be dust when you are cold."

King Romus Toras has ascended to the throne. His reign begins under geopolitical strife, contention between noble houses, and demands for the reclamation of lost lands. A monarch born into privilege yet crowned in crisis, Romus inherits a troubled realm and the burden of restoring the Golden Kingdom’s fractured prestige. 

The natural resource economy stagnates, welfare burdens strain the treasury, and whispers of reform grow louder within court and country. Inheriting a legacy both revered and contested, he must navigate a kingdom caught between tradition and transformation.
